evidence: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:141-142 computes both `start` and `end` from slotStartTime.hour()/minute(); slotEndTime (defined at :99) is never used, so the check at :143 `end > workingHour.endTime` is the start check repeated. A slot that starts inside working hours but runs past workingHour.endTime is never rejected. Fix: derive `end` from slotEndTime (and handle a slot ending at/after midnight UTC, where hour()*60 wraps to 0).

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:114 compares two newly created dayjs instances with `===`. That compares object references, so it is always false and the 'start equals end' (unavailable all day) branch never runs. getUserAvailability (packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:215-224) gives an 'unavailable' override start===end. When that branch is skipped, the checks at :117-125 still mark most slots unavailable, but a slot starting exactly at date.start is not rejected: slotEnd is after start and slotStart is not after end. Use `.isSame()` (e.g. dayjs(date.start).isSame(dayjs(date.end))).

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:102 `//check if date override...`. No eslint `spaced-comment` rule is configured in the repo. The codebase mostly uses `// ` (~2295 occurrences vs ~121 without a space in packages/ and apps/web), so adding the space matches convention. It is cosmetic only.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:137 `//if no date override...`. The same reasoning as issue 2 applies: there is no lint rule, the dominant style is `// `, and the change is cosmetic only.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:~579-585 is the selectedSlots (reserved-slot) pass. Its job is to check slots against `busy` built from selectedSlots (:~568-573). It runs only on availableTimeSlots, which earlier passes have already filtered: the fixed-host pass (:~487-497 spreads `...schedule`, which includes dateOverrides/workingHours) and the loose-host pass (:~514-516 spreads `...userSchedule`). Slots outside date overrides or working hours have already been removed, so this call cannot let a booking through at an unavailable time. Also, the call itself is not new in this PR; the PR only added organizerTimeZone, which has no effect here without dateOverrides and could simply be dropped.

apps/web/test/lib/getSchedule.test.ts:788-805: the only test added covers the date-override timezone fix for a single user. No test combines a fixed host (isFixed, ~:867) with a date override in a ROUND_ROBIN event (~:1052), so the fixed-host fix in slots.ts:487-497 (passing dateOverrides/workingHours through `...schedule` into checkIfIsAvailable) has no test. A test would also have caught issues 0 and 1. The PR description's test plan is manual, so the reviewer slightly overstates the claim that the description says this is covered.
